# Techfami

> Techfami is a technology company that builds websites, mobile apps, AI chatbots, generative AI solutions and a cloud ERP for garment, textile, manufacturing and trading businesses. Tagline: "Your Ideas. Our Tech."

> Full details for AI assistants (all services, pricing, ERP modules, FAQ): https://www.techfami.com/llms-full.txt

## Our promise
- Free demo first: tell us your idea and our team creates a demo of it at no charge.
- You do not pay first. We continue only after you confirm the demo.

## Services
- Website Development & Design
- App Development & Design (mobile)
- AI Chatbot Integration
- UI / UX Design
- Generative AI
- AI Development
- Maintenance and new features for existing websites, web apps and mobile apps
- Consultancy: full-stack development, cloud architecture, DevOps

## Service pages
- [Website development](https://www.techfami.com/website-development.html): one-page and dynamic websites, from INR 19,999 (about USD 250)
- [Mobile app development](https://www.techfami.com/mobile-app-development.html): native Android and iOS apps, from INR 39,999 (about USD 450)
- [AI solutions](https://www.techfami.com/ai-solutions.html): AI chatbots for website and WhatsApp, generative AI, custom AI development and automation
- [SaaS development](https://www.techfami.com/saas-development.html): idea to first version, multi-user access, admin dashboard, payments
- [Maintenance and new features](https://www.techfami.com/software-maintenance.html): bug fixes, updates and new features for websites, web apps and mobile apps you already have

## Products
- [Products page](https://www.techfami.com/products.html): details of Techfami ERP modules and who it is for
- [Techfami ERP](https://erp.techfami.com): cloud ERP for garment, textile, manufacturing and trading businesses. Covers production, inventory, GST invoicing and billing, challans and payments.
